summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0's yellow maze and Level 1's concrete Habitable Zone. world.config.yaml enters through main and wires shared player, camera and HUD behavior; each place simulates its own layout and supplies while shared player, combat, interaction and loot code follows players across place transitions.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's 56×56-cell maze and hub; cell scenes hold authored props/lights, while sim.js generates maze geometry, stairs, shifting walls, loot, crates and smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Level 1's 30×30-cell Habitable Zone; sim.js seeds concrete/rack geometry, lamps, supplies, M.E.G. arrival landmark and the return threshold, then runs the Flickering.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; cells contain stations, enemy pens, release pads and test objects, and sim.js restores test pickups and releases requested enemies.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry with main as default place, player/camera templates, gameplay inputs, lighting, arrival behavior, HUD and nametags.
templates/player.js - ordered player chain: humanoid-locomotion.js, player.js, interact.js, then critter.js.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - custom look-oriented camera; camera script owns yaw/pitch and display-frame camera/viewmodel updates.
places/main/config.yaml + places/main/cells/* - authored 3D Level 0 cells, hub and props; dynamic maze body is generated by places/main/sim.js using scripts/level0-geo.js.
places/level1/config.yaml + places/level1/sim.js - separate 3D Level 1 entry and its seeded world/environment loop; scripts/level1-geo.js builds its grid.
places/debug/config.yaml + places/debug/cells/* - separate 3D test room with stations, pens, triggers, labels and test objects.
places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - active place tick handlers; root sim.js is empty.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js - HUD entry and shared looting/inventory panels; world.config.yaml binds inventory to I.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - canonical Level 0 grid, zones, walls, arches, pits, pillars, hub, exit and gameplay tuning; geometry, player/enemy logic and simulation consume them.

scripts/lib/level1.js + scripts/lib/data/level1.yml - deterministic Level 1 grid/zones, room edges, pillars, racks, lamps and thresholds, plus Level 1 tuning; geometry, player logic and level simulation consume them.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - weapon stats, ammo, magazines/reload/ADS/recoil, melee charge and pickup/drop tuning used by player, loot, UI, debug and weapon presentation.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js - shared item-token descriptions and loose pickup, crate and remains creation; used by interaction, HUD, player and both active level simulations.
scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - common fitted weapon mesh/fallback presentation for floor pickups, debug stations and player viewmodels; meshes are prepared by art/weapons/build.py.
scripts/lib/shapes.js and scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - procedural mesh helpers and canonical debug station layout reused by geometry and debug scripts.
anim/creatures.yml + clips/anim-creatures-yml-*.json - named creature animation clips assigned by smiler and lurker behavior; clips/tracks-anim-*.json are saved engine tracks.
mods/modeling-studio/ - integrated creator/modeling tools and HUD, rendered through scripts/ui.js; scripts/lib/plyimport.js handles imported .plymodel conversion/upload.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/maze.js - Level 0 grid/zone/wall/arch/pit/pillar/exit helpers; scripts/lib/level1.js - Level 1 grid, zone, sector, edge, rack, lamp and threshold helpers.
scripts/lib/loot.js - spawnAlmond, spawnWeapon, spawnAmmo, spawnShells, rollWeapon, rollItem, spawnCrate, spawnRemains, dropLoot; scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - weaponBody.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, takeToken, onInput, reload callbacks, pumpRack, update; scripts/interact.js - onInput, update.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - update; scripts/level-door.js - onTriggerEnter; scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/critter.js - updateSchedule, blink/twitch callbacks, onInput, update; scripts/critter-geo.js - geometry, skeleton, collider; scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - wardrobe.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe; scripts/loot-ui.js - lootUi; scripts/lib/plyimport.js - plyToGlb, plyUpload, with plyUpload re-exported from scripts/ui.js.
scripts/level0-geo.js, scripts/level1-geo.js and creature/weapon/viewmodel geo scripts - geometry and applicable skeleton/collider exports; scripts/ui.js - render and modeling-studio HUD re-exports.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns persistent progression/XP, HP, sanity, stamina, battery, almonds, visited cells/zones, kills/escapes/deaths, weapons/ammo/magazines/equipped weapon and inventory/combat/reload controls.
scripts/interact.js - player.state focus, lootOpen, lootName, lootList and notice mirror current target/container UI; session holds ray/focus scratch; container state.items is its mutable token list.
scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns avatar appearance; outfits stores saved looks and wardrobe controls; mood/blink/twitch, mirror and rebuild scratch are session/local state.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - enemy state.hp/dead and AI prey/mode/gaze fields; per-enemy session carries path, animation and attack scratch.
places/main/sim.js - main place.state owns seed/refill times and per-player shifted-wall timers; generated stairs, shifted walls, loot, crates and enemies are entities.
places/level1/sim.js - Level 1 place.state owns seeded status and flicker schedule/phase/timing; generated geometry, lamps, supplies and return trigger are entities.
places/debug/sim.js - debug place.state owns seeded/refill timing and want_smiler/want_lurker release requests from pads.

scripts/camera.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js and mods/modeling-studio - camera owns yaw/pitch; camera/viewmodel motion scratch is local/session; studio world.state.m3d owns shared model/edit/bug records.
flows: world.config.yaml actions/axes → templates/player.js order: humanoid-locomotion.js reads prior movement, player.js writes movement/survival/combat, interact.js handles targeted use, critter.js handles avatar inputs and appearance.
world.config.yaml camera template → scripts/camera.js reads look input and owns yaw/pitch; movement and smiler eye-contact behavior consume aim/camera direction.

Level 0 exit condition in scripts/player.js → ctx.cross(player, 'level1'); Level 1 BACK trigger → scripts/level-door.js onTriggerEnter → ctx.cross(other, state.to='main'), with transition flash/sound.

interact/reload input → scripts/interact.js focus/container handler → scripts/lib/items.js tokens → scripts/player.js takeToken applies item effects; loose objects are consumed and container state.items is updated.

scripts/interact.js writes focus/lootOpen/lootList/notice → scripts/loot-ui.js via scripts/ui.js renders prompt/menu; menu actions return through loot actions, R takes all, E opens/closes and moving beyond 4.5 m closes.
places/main/sim.js and places/level1/sim.js use scripts/lib/loot.js to seed loot/crates; scripts/player.js dropLoot creates remains for defeated enemies; scripts/interact.js removes emptied remains.
I inventory input → scripts/player.js owns invOpen and handles loot-ui actions: equip, drink, drop (spawns weapon through scripts/lib/loot.js), close; inventory and loot panels exclude each other.
wardrobe (C), emote (T), dress action → scripts/critter.js onInput → player.state.look/outfits and creator controls → scripts/wardrobe-ui.js through scripts/ui.js.

scripts/critter.js turns player.state.look into params for scripts/critter-geo.js; procedural geometry powers replicated body and local wardrobe mirror, with mood clips and bone scaling for ears/tail/blinks.
wardrobe model upload → scripts/ui.js plyUpload → scripts/lib/plyimport.js converts/uploads .plymodel → dress modelUrl action → critter.js sets player.modelUrl.
player combat writes HP/sanity/weapons/ammo/ADS/reload and attack markers → scripts/ui.js HUD; attacks affect tagged smiler/lurker state, whose updates damage players and reward/drop loot on death.

scripts/player.js reload callbacks update loaded magazine/reserve counts; reload token/equipped checks reject stale callbacks; player.js viewmodel markers → scripts/camera.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js use weapons.yml tuning.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* authored lights - fluorescent fixtures repeat across maze cells, with red-zone variants; places/level1/sim.js separately lays a deterministic repeating tube/bulb lamp pattern that the Flickering toggles.

scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/figure-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js, scripts/lurker-geo.js, scripts/stairs-geo.js, scripts/weapon-geo.js, scripts/viewmodel-geo.js, scripts/level0-geo.js and scripts/level1-geo.js - procedural geometry reuses shared shape/layout helpers.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - parallel enemy loops share player targeting, maze path/line checks, bite/death/effect patterns; smilers react to light/eye contact, lurkers to gaze-freeze/sanity.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js - display-frame camera/viewmodel motion varies by weapon recoil, reload/sight/muzzle positions and melee charge tuning in weapons.yml.
scripts/critter-geo.js - procedural critter rig varies species, sex, body sliders, face/eye/mark choices and clothing/accessory slots; layered cloth uses fabric with shaded hems/cuffs.
scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - fitted Tripo meshes vary by weapon kind, with scripted fallback geometry for kinds without meshes; shared by pickups, viewmodels and debug placement.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js - one item-token vocabulary feeds loose pickups and randomized crate/enemy-remains contents; player/interact own application and collection.
scripts/lib/plyimport.js - imported .plymodels retain native joints/weights when present or use a mesh-fitted humanoid rig, then share avatar gait clips.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; all three places have terrain off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/data/level0.yml are coupled layout/gameplay: Level 0 is now 56×56 cells at 4 m each with a 3 m wall and hub cells 26–29; geometry, zones, spawns and AI must stay aligned.

Level 1 has its own independent 30×30 grid at 8 m/cell and 4.2 m height in scripts/lib/level1.js/data/level1.yml; scripts/player.js selects its zone names by place, while core player stats still use level0.yml tuning.
Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js and critter.js; locomotion reads prior movement before player control writes velocity.
Inventory/container contents are comma-separated item tokens (almond, ammo, shells, weapon:<kind>); scripts/lib/items.js describes them and scripts/player.js takeToken applies them.
critter-geo.js bone names Tail, Tail1, EarL/EarR and LidL/LidR are shared by jiggle, mood and blink; preserve bone names and gait/mood track separation.

weapons.yml keys/order, ammoType, magSize, ADS/recoil and melee charge fields couple cycling, reload, loot, UI, debug, weapon meshes and vmpose; weapon-look mesh offsets keep the old floor-origin frame.
